result:
I've repaired F-DG3-280: the lint test now lints every row of the probe table except the two that can't be parsed. Both required mutation runs fail, and every acceptance check exited 0. Changes are uncommitted on `dg3/kbe-i`.

**What changed in `fuzz.test.ts`**
- **Every row is linted.** The probe table now has 101 rows. The test lints 99 of them and checks that the count is exactly 99, so a row can't be skipped silently.
- **Two rows are excluded, by name.** `const s = "unclosed;` (unterminated string) and `function f() {` (unclosed block) are listed in `LINT_EXCLUDED` with their reasons, and must be parse errors instead. A separate small test checks that list against the probe table.
- **A refusal now has to come from a guard rule.** The test used to accept any rule. `class C { #then() {} }` was also flagged by `no-unused-vars` ("'C' is defined but never used"), which hid the removal of the `PrivateIdentifier` selector. My first widened version passed that mutation because of this. Now one of the formula block's seven guard rules must refuse each row (`no-eval`, `no-implied-eval`, `no-new-func`, `no-restricted-globals`, `no-restricted-imports`, `no-restricted-syntax`, `no-unsafe-finally`). This makes the test stricter and weakens nothing F-DG3-100 relies on.
- **Two new rows** (`#then`, `#fromAsync`). No existing row used a private name, so nothing exercised that part of the selector.
- **No lint gap.** All 99 rows are refused by a guard rule, so `eslint.config.js` is unchanged.

**Mutation runs** (in a disposable copy, deleted afterwards)

| Change to `eslint.config.js` | Result |
|---|---|
| removed `ForOfStatement[await=true]` | exit 1, on the `for await` row |
| removed the `PrivateIdentifier[…]` part | exit 1, on the `class C { #then() {} }` row |
| restored | exit 0, 111 passed |

**Docs**
- **ADR-0024 §6:** only the lintText sentence changed. It now names the two excluded rows and why, and the guard-rule requirement.
- **`p3-work-split.md` §9:** item 29, under a round-7 heading.

**Checks**
- `pnpm -r typecheck`, `pnpm -r build`, `pnpm lint`, the prettier check and the formula `eslint` run all exited 0.
- `validate.mjs --historical --stage DG2` exited 0 before and after the change.
- `pnpm test` exited 0 on Node 24 and Node 22, with the locale unset and with `C.UTF-8`. Each run had 1654 passed, and 259 passed with 2 skipped. That is 3 more per invocation than the round-6 baseline (1651 + 256): the 2 new rows and the exclusion-list test. The 2 skipped tests are the same as before.

**Not done or not covered**
- I didn't run the integration tests (`pnpm test:integration`); the assignment doesn't require them.
- I only tested the two removals the assignment names. Removing some other selector parts could still be hidden by an overlapping selector on the same rows (for example, `p["then"]` is caught by two). Lint would still refuse those forms.
- The `mutations.log` failures are the intended ones.

Files are in `docs/delivery/handbacks/DG3/`:
- `T-DG3-KBE-I-kpi-benefits-engineer.md`
- `T-DG3-KBE-I-evidence/` (the scripts and logs, including `mutations.log`)
